# Code Anchors: HLD Page as Build Input

- `libs/portable-tools/src/implement-hld.ts` — reads the HLD comment: the marker, the trust filter, the newest pick, the stated digest, the verdict and its clean match, the design link, and the page copy's location
- `libs/portable-tools/src/implement.ts` — the preflight lookup, the stale then verdict then fetch order, the stops before the branch, the page copy, the record-only option, and the prompt paragraph
- `libs/portable-tools/src/implement.spec.ts` — coverage for every lookup outcome, prompt identity without a page, and the test that fails when the design page's comment template changes
- `libs/delivery-config/src/asset-publish.ts` — turns a pinned page link back into store, commit and path, beside the code that builds that link
- `libs/delivery-config/src/asset-publish.spec.ts` — pins that the parse inverts the built address and refuses a branch or short commit
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the record-only option and its usage text
- `components/skills/nxs.hld/SKILL.md` — the stage that posts the HLD comment this command reads
